title: Manager - Infrastructure Control Operator (ICO)
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 Northern Trust is looking for an Infrastructure Control Operator (ICO) to play a vital role in supporting and maintaining infrastructure\-related controls throughout the organization. This position is responsible for ensuring adherence to internal risk frameworks, infrastructure standards, and regulatory requirements. Key duties include performing control related activities, monitoring control performance, maintaining comprehensive documentation, and supporting both internal and external audits. The successful candidate will demonstrate consistent achievement of SLA commitments and timely execution of control tasks.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership \& Oversight**
* Supervise day\-to\-day operations of the Infrastructure Control Operator team.
* Assign tasks, monitor performance, and ensure timely execution of control activities.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and training to staff to ensure consistent quality and compliance.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as a liaison between control operations and infrastructure, risk, and compliance teams.
* Facilitate communication and alignment across teams to ensure control objectives are met.


**Control Execution**
* Perform routine Business\-As\-Usual (BAU) control operations.
* Execute all control procedures efficiently and within designated timelines.


**Monitor Performance**
* Evaluate control performance regularly, escalating concerns as appropriate.


**Reporting And Metrics**
* Prepare and deliver pre\-defined periodic reports on control operations, exceptions, and utilization status
* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) relevant to control activities.


**Evidence Readiness**
* Maintain complete and compliant records of all control operational activities, adhering to internal standards and regulatory obligations.
* Organize and provide evidence promptly for audit purposes or stakeholder requests.


**Internal/External Audit Support**
* Facilitate internal and external audits by supplying required documentation and evidence.
* Assist with the preparation, coordination, and follow\-up of audit responses and remedial measures as necessary.


**Collaboration**
* Work collaboratively with stakeholders to ensuring adherence to both internal policies and external regulatory standards.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.


**Must Haves**
* Proven experience in Infrastructure controls, risk management, or infrastructure support roles, preferably in regulated environments.
* Hands on experience in Control Testing, SOX/SOC audit.
* Review control checklists and playbooks for completeness, accuracy, and effectiveness.
* Ability to clearly document control operations in a structured playbook format, enabling its use as a standardized and repeatable checklist for execution and compliance.
* Understanding of infrastructure platforms and infrastructure standards.
* Hands on experience in operating and tracking controls effectively.
* Strong reporting skills, tracking and maintaining KPIs.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with different teams effectively.
* Ability to identify reporting anomalies and escalate issues appropriately.
* Practical knowledge of creating Microsoft 365 Copilot agents with clear instructions, defined scope, and appropriate source grounding.

**Good To Have**
* Service\-Now and Power BI experience as user.
* Highly motivated, energetic self\-starter who takes ownership of issues and drives them to resolution.
* Good organizational skills \- manages and prioritizes multiple tasks across different time horizons within deadlines.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and process re\-engineering skills.
* Experience with control monitoring tools and systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
* Familiarity with control frameworks, risk management practices, and compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, SOX, etc.).


**Required Skills**
 As a partner at Northern Trust, you must actively manage and mitigate risk and act with integrity. In accordance with our core values of service, integrity, and expertise, you are expected to:
   

  

* Adhere to all applicable risk management programs, policies, and procedures.

* Ensure that Northern Trust or its clients are not exposed to inappropriate or excessive risk.

title: Factory Manager- Aluminium Facades
description:
Production Manager – Aluminium Façades
 



**Company:** 
 McCoy Architectural Systems Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Chakan, Pune
 



**Department:** 
 Aluminium Façades Manufacturing
 



**Reports to:** 
 Plant Head / Factory Manager
 



**Direct reports:** 
 Production Engineers, Supervisors, Operators, Assembly Technicians and Helpers
 



**Functional coordination:** 
 Engineering, PPC, Quality, Procurement, Stores, Maintenance, EHS and Site Installation
 



 This role is tailored for an architectural façade manufacturing environment involving aluminium façade systems, skylights and related building\-envelope products.
 



 Job purpose
 



 To plan, manage and control aluminium façade production so that products are manufactured safely, accurately, economically and according to approved drawings, project schedules and quality requirements.
 



 Key responsibilities
 



 Production planning and execution
 


* Execute production plans issued by PPC.
* Manage cutting, CNC machining, routing, drilling, assembly and packing activities.
* Ensure correct production sequencing for stick, unitised, semi\-unitised, curtain\-wall and cladding systems.
* Allocate manpower, machines, tools and workstations.
* Monitor daily production against planned quantities and project milestones.
* Coordinate production priorities with Engineering, PPC and Project Management.



 Technical and drawing control
 


* Ensure production uses only approved and revision\-controlled drawings.
* Verify profiles, accessories, glass, brackets, fasteners, gaskets and sealants before production.
* Review fabrication drawings, cutting lists, BOMs and assembly instructions.
* Identify design or constructability issues before production starts.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with the Engineering Department.



 Quality control
 


* Ensure correct profile dimensions, cutting accuracy, drilling positions and assembly tolerances.
* Control joint preparation, corner crimping, screw fixing, sealing and gasket installation.
* Ensure correct use of approved sealants, tapes, fasteners and accessories.
* Coordinate first\-piece inspection and in\-process inspection with QA/QC.
* Reduce rejection, leakage risk, scratches, dents, colour mismatch and rework.
* Support mock\-ups, performance testing and customer inspections.



 Manpower and shop\-floor management
 


* Supervise production supervisors and shift teams.
* Maintain skill matrices and arrange operator training.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, overtime and labour productivity.
* Establish standard work instructions for repetitive operations.
* Promote 5S, visual management and continuous improvement.



 Material and inventory control
 


* Coordinate with Stores for timely availability of aluminium profiles and accessories.
* Control material identification, batch traceability and project\-wise segregation.
* Minimise profile wastage and damage during handling.
* Ensure proper protection of finished components before dispatch.
* Report shortages, excess consumption and material discrepancies.



 Equipment and maintenance
 


* Ensure proper operation of saws, CNC machines, routers, drilling machines, crimping machines and assembly tools.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance with the Maintenance Department.
* Report machine breakdowns and production losses promptly.
* Ensure calibration and condition of measuring instruments and jigs.



 Safety and compliance
 


* Enforce PPE, safe material handling and machine\-guarding requirements.
* Ensure safe use of sealants, solvents, adhesives and cutting equipment.
* Conduct toolbox talks and shop\-floor safety inspections.
* Stop unsafe work and report incidents or near misses.
* Maintain good housekeeping and emergency access routes.



 Dispatch and site coordination
 


* Coordinate packing and dispatch in the required installation sequence.
* Ensure identification marks, labels, packing lists and project documents are complete.
* Support site teams with installation feedback and technical clarification.
* Analyse site complaints and implement corrective actions in production.



 Key performance indicators
 


* Production plan achievement
* On\-time project dispatch
* Labour productivity
* First\-pass quality acceptance
* Rework and rejection percentage
* Aluminium profile utilisation and wastage
* Machine utilisation and downtime
* Material damage during production
* Customer/site complaints
* Safety observations and incidents
* 5S and housekeeping audit score



 Decision\-making authority
 



 The Production Manager may:
 


* Allocate manpower and production resources.
* Re\-sequence work within approved project priorities.
* Hold defective or damaged material for inspection.
* Stop production where drawings, materials or safety conditions are inadequate.
* Recommend overtime, subcontracting or additional manpower.
* Initiate corrective action for recurring production problems.



 Changes to design, specifications, material grades, finishes or approved drawings require Engineering and Quality approval.
 



 Qualification
 


* Degree or diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering.
* Additional knowledge of aluminium façade systems, curtain walls, cladding or glazing is preferred.
* Knowledge of CAD drawings, BOMs, production planning and inspection procedures.



 Experience
 


* 8–12 years in aluminium façade, curtain\-wall, cladding, glazing or architectural metal manufacturing.
* Experience supervising a project\-based, customised production environment.
* Experience with aluminium profiles, CNC machining, façade accessories and assembly tolerances.
* Exposure to site installation and façade mock\-up requirements is desirable.



 Required skills
 


* Aluminium façade production knowledge
* Production planning and manpower control
* Drawing and BOM interpretation
* Problem\-solving and root\-cause analysis
* Quality and dimensional\-control awareness
* ERP/MIS reporting
* Vendor and subcontractor coordination
* Team leadership and communication
* Strong safety and housekeeping discipline



 Personal attributes
 


* Hands\-on shop\-floor leadership
* Strong attention to dimensional and finish quality
* Ability to work under project deadlines
* Practical and systematic problem\-solving approach
* Willingness to work in shifts when required
* High ownership for delivery and customer satisfaction

**The Accounting Operations Manager (AOM) is responsible for end\-to\-end client delivery, financial accuracy, team leadership, and operational excellence. The role oversees month\-end close, reporting, audit and tax coordination, client communication, and process improvement while leading and developing a high\-performing accounting team.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Management \& Communication** 



* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing all communication channels.
* Prepare and lead client meetings with agendas, clear updates, and documented action items.
* Understand client businesses, priorities, and pain points by reviewing financials and business information, and proactively align deliverables with client goals.
* Customize reports, respond to ad\-hoc requests, resolve complex accounting queries, and handle escalations professionally.
* Maintain strong written and verbal communication, ensuring clarity, professionalism, and timely follow\-ups.



  





**Financial Close, Reporting \& Technical Oversight** 



* Review and oversee
 **month\-end close for all clients** 
 , ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
* Maintain hands\-on expertise in core accounting processes (AP, AR, Bank Rec, Payroll, 941, accruals, AJEs) to guide the team effectively.
* Conduct financial reviews, trend analysis, and variance investigations, providing actionable insights.
* Customize and review financial reports, forecasts, and budgets as per client requirements.
* Monitor and update forecasting tools and ensure reporting accuracy.
* Finalize and file 1099s and ensure compliance with US GAAP and applicable regulations.



  





**Audit, Tax \& Compliance Support** 



* Review audit and tax preparation files, including schedules and adjustment journal entries, before submission.
* Coordinate with auditors, respond to queries, and ensure smooth completion of audits.
* Monitor audit, tax, fiscal close trackers and ensure deadlines are met.



  





**Team Leadership \& Resource Management** 



* Plan workloads, assign tasks based on capacity and skills, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Monitor task status, time tracking, efficiency, and budget adherence using Canopy.
* Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to team members; identify skill gaps and plan training and provide regular feedbacks.
* Manage escalations, leave management, and ensure backup coverage when needed.
* Foster trust\-based delegation, emotional intelligence, and strong team communication.
* Support onboarding and training of new senior team members and cover for Senior Associates when required.



  





**Operational Excellence \& Process Improvement** 



* Standardize, develop, and improve accounting processes to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Finalize SOPs and ensure alignment with US Engagement Managers.
* Oversee client onboarding, new app implementations, and project\-based work.
* Ensure team adherence to required trackers, documentation, and internal controls.
* Leverage technology and tools to streamline workflows, reporting, and communication.



  





**Collaboration, Culture \& Leadership** 



* Partner with TAL, US stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery.
* Promote a positive, accountable, and collaborative work environment.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities and remote/hybrid team dynamics.
* Lead by example, reinforcing company values of transparency, collaboration, generosity, and self\-discipline.



  










**Requirements** 




 ● Minimum Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field, MBA or CA preferred
 



 ● Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software.
 



 ● The successful candidate will have a strong background in GL accounting and experience working with US GAAP. AP background not required.
 



 ● Thorough understanding of nonprofit accounting principles added advantage.
 



 ● Ability to apply accounting principles and solutions to meet unique client needs and clearly articulate proposed solutions to client’s problems
 



 ● Willingness to work from office or home or in hybrid model as per the requirements

**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking
 ***Manager Database Operations Manager***
 to join our
 ***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
 in Global Technology \& Operations.
   

  

**Team/Group Description**
 This position operates in a fast\-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On\-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high\-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**
* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase \& IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T\-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.


**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**
* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross\-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high\-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server\-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

**Job Title: Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience** 




**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)** 




**Permanent \- Full Time** 




  





**About Us:** 




 Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.
 



  





 Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
 



  





 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.
 



  





**About The Role:** 




 The Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience is a relationship and governance role, not a target\-carrying operations role. You own the mechanism that makes the partnership work: the reporting, cadence, coordination, and health of the relationship. The delivery targets themselves (service levels, quality and cost) sit with the operational leaders. Your job is to make sure the partner always knows what is expected and where they stand, and that Cyncly leaders always have an accurate, current picture of the performance outputs of the BPO. Leaders such as our CX Domain Directors, SVP CX, CCO, and wider executive members.
 



  





 We work with a strategic outsourcing (BPO) partner to deliver customer support across multiple domains, product lines, and regions. This role is the single point of contact between Cyncly and that partner.
 



  





 You will keep a clear, consistent, and trusted view of how the relationship is performing, so that everyone on both sides always knows where things stand. You will stand the partnership up through transition and go\-live and then run the ongoing relationship day to day.
 



  





 The role is designed to expand as trust is earned: at the start, you stand up the mechanism, get reporting flowing, establish the governance cadence and make the transition land cleanly; as the relationship settles, you move from reactive to proactive by anticipating risks, championing change and building a genuine joint team; and in the mature relationship, you become a true partnership steward, keeping leadership sponsorship sharp and the relationship healthy and honest. The through\-line is a move from running the reporting to making the partnership succeed.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities:** 



* Act as the single point of contact for Cyncly's outsourcing partner across operational, reporting and relationship matters.
* Build and run the governance rhythm, including performance reporting, review meetings, quarterly business reviews, agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
* Produce clear, accurate performance reporting and maintain one consistent view of how the partnership is performing, creating a single trusted version rather than different stories across the business.
* Route and coordinate escalations to the right owners and drive them through to resolution.
* Coordinate capacity, workforce planning, and forecasting between partner and internal teams.
* Track risks, actions, issues and decisions, and surface emerging risks early.
* Lead Cyncly's side of the transition and go\-live, partnering closely with the provider's transition team, then carrying the relationship into a steady state.
* Champion continuous improvement and a genuine one\-team relationship built on trust and honest communication rather than adversarial vendor management.



  





**Required Skills and Experience:** 




**Experience** 



* Typically 8 to 14 years of experience in customer experience, contact center or BPO delivery, including experience managing or governing an outsourced engagement from the client side.
* Equivalent experience is valued; formal project, programme or partnership\-management credentials are welcomed where they support the role, but are not the primary requirement.
* Strong governance, project and relationship\-management discipline across cadence, reporting, risk tracking and stakeholder communication.
* Credibility and presence to hold governance with senior stakeholders on both sides, and to represent the business well.
* Solid grounding in contact\-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, customer satisfaction and quality, so you can coordinate meaningfully and interrogate the numbers.
* Comfort working with delivery data and reporting tools, and manipulating such data to be presented in a variety of formats to varying stakeholders of varying seniority
* Experience with Zendesk or a comparable ITSM/CCaaS customer service platform(s).
* Ability to create trust, maintain clarity, and build a one\-team relationship with an outsourcing partner while keeping accountability clear.
* Experience working in global teams \& managing stakeholders across geographies.



  





**Preferred but not required** 



* Experience standing up or transitioning outsourced engagement, with exposure to commercial negotiations and management.
* A project or programme management background, for example PMP certification.
* Experience across multiple regions and product areas.



  





**Working For Us:** 




 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
 



  





 Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
 



  





 We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
 



  





 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn\*\*—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them

Manages the procurement within a business unit, commodity group, or international region for all materials, supplies, and equipment in support of corporate procurement operations and goals. Ensures procurement activities reflect diverse requirements and overall business goals, as well as complies with all regulatory standards.

 Manages end\-to\-end procurement strategies and processes that capitalize on savings and risk mitigation opportunities for the business. Builds strong supplier relationships. and encourages a high level of supplier collaboration and delivery. Solves complex matters of supplier performance. Contributes to and implements overall procurement strategy that provides foundation for supplier negotiations.  Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

 Negotiations Excellence \- Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

 Supplier Contract Development \- Develops contracts based on the templates available that cover commercial and legal relationship between Cummins and supplier; incorporates commercial requirements and legal requirements in the region(s) that are covered by the contracts; drives engagement between stakeholders following the Supplier Agreement Contracting Process (SACP) and negotiations excellence skills.

 Significant level of relevant work experience required.

**Lead, Business Continuity Manager (APAC Location)**
**Location**

**Position Summary**
 The Lead, Business Continuity Management (APAC Location) is responsible for the development, implementation, governance, testing, and continuous improvement of Business Continuity Management (BCM).
   

  

 This role serves as the primary APAC focal point for technology continuity planning while partnering with global technology teams, infrastructure organizations, cybersecurity, enterprise risk management, business units, and regional regulators. The incumbent will ensure that critical technology services can withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptive events while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regional regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The role requires balancing regional execution with global alignment, ensuring APAC\-specific risks, regulatory obligations, and operational requirements are effectively incorporated into the enterprise resilience framework.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Continuity Strategy \& Governance**
* Lead the APAC Technology Business Continuity Program.
* Develop and maintain regional technology continuity and resilience strategies aligned with global frameworks.
* Ensure regional BCM practices are aligned with enterprise risk management standards and global technology policies.
* Establish governance forums, metrics, reporting, and executive dashboards for continuity and resilience programs.
* Support annual reviews of continuity policies, standards, procedures, and recovery strategies.


**Continuity Planning \& Preparedness**
* Develop, maintain, and govern Technology Business Continuity Plans (BCPs).
* Ensure recovery plans exist for critical platforms, infrastructure services, applications, and technology processes.
* Coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) and risk assessments across APAC technology functions.
* Assess dependencies involving third\-party vendors, cloud service providers, and critical technology partners.
* Maintain inventories of critical services, applications, recovery strategies, and recovery objectives.


**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience Testing**
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing programs across APAC technology teams.
* Manage tabletop exercises, simulation exercises, crisis management drills, and failover testing activities.
* Validate Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Track remediation of gaps identified through testing and post\-incident reviews.
* Produce executive summaries and lessons\-learned reports following exercises.


**Operational Resilience**
* Support identification and mapping of Important Business Services (IBS) and technology dependencies.
* Assess resilience vulnerabilities across people, process, technology, facilities, and third\-party ecosystems.
* Assist in establishing impact tolerances and resilience performance measures.
* Support enterprise operational resilience initiatives and regional regulatory requirements.


**Crisis Management \& Incident Response**
* Support technology crisis management and major incident response activities.
* Participate in regional command centers during significant incidents.
* Coordinate communications, issue escalation, decision tracking, and recovery governance during disruptions.
* Facilitate post\-incident reviews and corrective action plans.

* Partner with:
+ Infrastructure Engineering
+ Cyber Security
+ IT Operations
+ Technology Risk Management
+ Enterprise Risk
+ Corporate Services
+ Business Units

* Provide guidance and coaching to technology teams regarding continuity planning requirements.

**Education**
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**
* CBCP (Certified Business Continuity Professional)
* MBCI (Member, Business Continuity Institute)

* ITIL


**Experience**

* Experience supporting large\-scale global technology environments.
* Experience managing regulatory, audit, and risk management engagements.

 We are looking for a Global Supply Chain Manager to own the end to end supply chain for Sibros hardware. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role. You will own supplier relationships and agreements, demand planning against long component lead times, global trade and customs compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India, carrier and third party logistics partnerships, and the inventory system of record. You will set the policies that govern how we forecast, buy, hold, move, and return hardware, and you will be accountable for the cost, timing, and compliance of every unit that moves.
   

  

 The role sits at the point where customer commitments meet supplier capacity. Component lead times run six to twelve months, we order against forecasts ahead of customer purchase orders, and we are building our own telematics control unit alongside our existing supplier portfolio. You will own the risk that sits inside that gap. You will work directly with Finance on inventory exposure, with Sales and Technical Program Management on customer commitments, with Legal on supplier and export compliance, and with Engineering on new product introduction.
   

  

 This role is built for someone who raises problems early, escalates without being asked, and closes them without being chased.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Supplier Management and Procurement\- Own supplier relationships end to end, from qualification and onboarding through agreement execution and ongoing commercial management. Ensure every supplier is onboarded under a signed agreement before we transact. Issue approved purchase orders to suppliers within 24 hours and drive supplier follow through to committed dates.
* Demand Planning and Inventory Strategy\- Build and maintain the rolling demand forecast that long component lead times require. Set and maintain regional buffer stock levels and reorder points. Own the inventory position against both committed and forecast customer demand, and surface working capital exposure to Finance before it is committed rather than after.
* Global Trade and Customs Compliance\- Own import and export compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India. Maintain entity registrations, EORI and VAT numbers, product classifications, Incoterms, and customs broker relationships. Ensure every shipment departs with complete and correct documentation so that clearance is routine rather than an escalation.
* Logistics, Carrier, and 3PL Management\- Own carrier and third party logistics relationships, contracts, and rates. Manage freight and landed cost per unit as a reported metric with a target. Own shipment escalation end to end, including direct escalation into carriers, so that Engineering and Technical Program Management are never asked to execute logistics work.
* Returns, Warranty, and Device Lifecycle\- Own the returns and warranty process from customer intake through supplier claim and closure. Maintain unit level traceability across serial number, IMEI, and SIM for every device from receipt through decommissioning.
* Systems, Reporting, and Process Ownership\- Own the inventory system of record and its accuracy. Maintain the operating procedures and runbooks that govern the hardware process. Publish the weekly open order report, the monthly inventory reconciliation, and the quarterly demand forecast, and hold the numbers to an audit ready standard.
* New Product Introduction Support\- Support the launch of Sibros designed hardware by owning supplier selection, component sourcing strategy, contract manufacturer evaluation, and the supply chain readiness plan from prototype through production.


**What You Should Know**
* Education: Bachelor's / Master's degree in any discipline.
* Professional Experience: 8\+ years in supply chain, procurement, or global logistics, including at least 3 years owning a function rather than executing within one.
* Demand Planning: Demonstrated ownership of a demand forecast against component or finished goods lead times of six months or longer, including buffer stock policy and reorder point setting.
* Trade Compliance: Hands on ownership of import and export documentation and customs clearance in at least two of the United States, the European Union, and India, including direct management of customs brokers.
* Commercial Management: Experience negotiating and managing supplier, carrier, and third party logistics contracts, and managing freight and landed cost as a controlled expense.
* Systems: Ownership of an ERP or inventory management system as the system of record, with advanced Excel and Google Sheets capability for reconciliation and reporting.
* Ownership and Escalation: A proven record of raising risks early, escalating without prompting, and closing issues without follow up. This is the most important requirement of the role.
* Communication: Clear and timely communication across the United States, European Union, and India time zones with internal teams, suppliers, carriers, and customers.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field. APICS CPIM, APICS CSCP, or CIPS certification.
* Industry Context: Experience in hardware enabled, IoT, automotive, or embedded systems environments, including exposure to automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949\.
* New Product Introduction: Experience taking a new hardware product from prototype to volume production, including electronics manufacturing services and contract manufacturer selection.
* Regional Expertise: Established customs broker and freight forwarder relationships in India, and working familiarity with the India to European Union and India to United States shipping lanes.
* ERP Proficiency: Experience with NetSuite, Odoo, Zoho, QuickBooks, or other ERP and inventory tools, and with Jira as an operational workflow system.
* Lifecycle Management: Exposure to returns, reverse logistics, refurbishment, and end of life device disposition.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives.
* Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement.
* Learning \& Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs.
* Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off, you decide when you need a break.
* Team Culture: Regular team events, off\-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.


 Employment Opportunity

We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, age, sex, ancestry, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, present or past history of mental disability, genetic information or any other classification protected by state or federal law.

 Position Overview: The Assistant Manager – Ocean Operations will be responsible for managing and overseeing end\-to\-end ocean freight operations, covering both FCL and LCL shipments. **Key Responsibilities:** 



* End\-to\-End Ocean Freight Operations:
* Manage the complete lifecycle of FCL and LCL ocean shipments, from shipment planning and booking through documentation, vessel movement, tracking, and final delivery.
* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, warehouses, and other logistics partners for smooth shipment execution.
* Handle shipment bookings, vessel schedules, cut\-off timelines, cargo readiness, container planning, and documentation requirements.
* Monitor shipment milestones and proactively follow up on delays, rollovers, schedule changes, container\-related issues, and other operational exceptions.

* Ensure shipments are executed within agreed timelines and operational requirements.
* Handle day\-to\-day operational queries and resolve shipment\-related issues through effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

* Monitor container and cargo movement and ensure timely escalation of operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with warehouses, suppliers, freight forwarders, and transporters to ensure cargo is available and moved as per the planned sailing schedule.



**Documentation \& Trade Compliance:** 



* Ensure accurate and timely preparation, verification, and submission of ocean shipping documentation.

* Ensure alignment between shipment requirements, cargo readiness, documentation, and delivery timelines.
* Handle operational escalations and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.



  





**Team Coordination \& Support:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day operational guidance and support to team members handling ocean freight activities.
* Support the team in managing FCL and LCL shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Review operational activities for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with defined processes.
* Train and guide junior team members on ocean freight processes, documentation, systems, and operational procedures.
* Support the team in resolving complex shipment\-related issues and exceptions.
* Ensure appropriate allocation and prioritization of operational activities within the team.



  





**Cost Control \& Process Improvement:** 



* Identify opportunities to improve ocean freight processes, shipment planning, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Monitor and minimize avoidable costs such as demurrage, detention, storage, documentation charges, and other operational expenses.
* Support freight and logistics cost optimization through effective shipment planning and coordination.
* Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of SOPs, process controls, and operational best practices.
* Monitor key operational performance indicators and support continuous improvement initiatives.

 Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Commerce, or a

description:
**About us** 




 Gatti Chutney is a premium South Indian QSR specialising in Bangalore\-style dosas, with three outlets in Pune (Koregaon Park, Baner, Kharadi). Every batter, chutney and base is made in our Central Kitchen and sent to the outlets daily, so the CK is the heart of the brand. We're open 365 days a year.
 



**The role** 




 You'll own the Central Kitchen end to end: what gets made, how it tastes, what it costs, and how it reaches the outlets. You'll also lead menu R\&D and launch one new dish every month.
 



**Key responsibilities** 




*Production \& consistency* 



* Run daily production of dosa and idli batters, chutneys, sambar, palya and other prep strictly as per company SOPs and standard recipes
* Plan production against outlet indents and ensure on\-time, complete dispatch
* Control batter fermentation and chutney consistency across batches and seasons
* Maintain standard recipes with defined yields and portion specs



*Quality \& food safety* 



* Check incoming raw material for quality, weight and expiry; reject non\-conforming stock
* QC every batch before dispatch (taste, texture, temperature, labelling with batch/prep date/use\-by)
* Enforce FIFO/FEFO, shelf\-life rules and cold chain from CK to outlet
* Keep the CK FSSAI\-compliant and audit\-ready: hygiene, pest control, water testing, periodic lab testing
* Investigate outlet quality complaints and fix the root cause



*Food cost \& wastage* 



* Keep food cost within company target; track yields and variances
* Record, analyse and reduce CK wastage
* Conduct stock counts and reconcile consumption against production
* Work with purchase on raw material specs, vendor quality and pricing



*R\&D \& menu* 



* Launch one new dish every month: develop, cost, trial, write the SOP and train outlet teams
* Create seasonal and festive specials
* Improve existing recipes for taste, cost and shelf life



*Team* 



* Lead the CK team: rostering for 365\-day operations, training, hygiene discipline, performance
* Train outlet kitchen teams on new dishes and SOP updates; do regular outlet taste audits
* Develop a second\-in\-command



*Equipment \& reporting* 



* Ensure upkeep of grinders, kettles and cold storage with a preventive maintenance schedule
* Share daily production, dispatch and wastage reports; monthly food cost and R\&D update to founders



**What we're looking for** 



* 5\+ years in South Indian kitchen
* Hands\-on mastery For South Indian dishes
* Strong in recipe costing, yield control and inventory management
* FSSAI FoSTaC (Food Safety Supervisor) certified, or willing to get certified
* Comfortable with Excel and POS/inventory software (we use Petpooja)
* A floor leader, not a desk chef



**How you'll be measured** 




 Food cost %, CK wastage %, on\-time dispatch and fill rate, outlet quality complaints, audit scores, one new dish launched every month.
 



**What we offer** 



* ₹65k–90k/month based on experience
* Annual bonus
* 30 paid leaves a year, plus weekly off
* Accommodation
* 3 meals a day
* PF and gratuity as per law
* The chance to build the kitchen behind a growing premium brand
